info.description:
Better Metadata - Better Science

The messaging server carries messages to CEDAR users: what the workbench shows as a
notification, and what a background process sends when it has something to report.

Every endpoint acts on the caller's own messages. Sending in a process's name is the one thing
here that needs a permission beyond being logged in.
info.title: CEDAR Messaging Server API

post.description: Mark all of the caller's unread messages read at once, and report how many that was. Acts only on the caller's own messages.

200.description: How many messages were marked read

get.description: Return the caller's messages along with the same counts the summary reports. A sender whose display name cannot be resolved — a deleted account, or the user server being unreachable — is returned without one rather than failing the listing.

parameters.description: Return only messages in this notification state. Omit it for all of them.
parameters.name: notification_status

200.description: The caller's messages, with total, unread and not-notified counts

400.description: The notification status is not one of the accepted values

post.description: Send a message to one user. The recipient is required and must be a user: broadcast is not supported. The sender defaults to the caller; naming a sender means sending on behalf of a process, which needs the process-message permission.

400.description: No recipient, an unsupported recipient type, or a named sender that is not a known process

403.description: Sending in a process's name without the permission to do so

patch.description: Change the notification state of one of the caller's own messages, as a JSON merge patch carrying `notificationStatus`. Nothing else about a message can be changed.

400.description: The notification status is missing or not one of the accepted values

403.description: The message belongs to someone else

get.description: Report how many messages the caller has in total, how many are unread, and how many have not yet been notified. This is the counts alone, for a workbench badge that does not want the messages themselves.

api_key.description: Your CEDAR API key, using the format 'apiKey <yourApiKey>'
